C0918.title: U.S. Busts $200 Million International Credit Card Fraud Ring, 18 Indicted
C0918.summary: In 2013, the FBI arrested 13 suspects in New Jersey and elsewhere for their alleged involvement in a large-scale international credit card fraud scheme. The group was accused of creating thousands of synthetic identities and using counterfeit credit cards to conduct fraudulent transactions, resulting in at least $200 million in losses.
